hashNote: SHA-256 of implementation bytes committed at 170c3d394fea060ec8f96383d056958340c87ec7, verified by root and tester before that commit. The later comment-only follow-up is recorded separately below. No private file or source bytes are included.
behavior: safeError uses an unexported per-process random 32-byte key for HMAC-SHA-256 message tags, truncated to eight hex characters. Its whole body is guarded; throwing getters, proxies or label conversion use the constant fallback.

Repository and fixtures roots are realpathed. Private file names, locations, links, size, raw hashes, analysis shape and effective-input hashes remain checked. The test-only expected source hash has no environment bypass.

After missing/location/unpinned checks and before private file reads, the harness checks committed manifest/source-definition pins and cluster freshness. Private mode requires MP_PRIVATE_FRESH_CLUSTER=1, only standard/admin databases and no robot_pa_ roles. Freshness is checked again before context creation; database log controls are installed and verified before private DB writes.

Provenance records SHA-256 and HEAD equality for manifest, source-hash definition and all three harness files. Missing Git fails closed. Private manifest/source pins must match HEAD. End cleanliness is recorded; end provenance failure still flushes cleanup evidence and fails the run.

Cleanup records every tracked database and role drop, numeric remaining counts and verification status. Failed drops, leftover objects or cleanup errors fail the run. The owner must dispose of the private cluster data directory; dropping a database alone does not erase private WAL.
Owner and Bot reuse is refused before another holdout admission/execution; intentional reads and refused freshness probes do not consume another holdout.

Summary writing enforces decision NONE and exact NOT_RUN/CHECKS_HELD/CHECKS_FAILED statuses. Static checks also reject test diagnostics, warnings, debug logging and assert calls in private case bodies. Summary output stays ignored.

Each deployment selection comes from its own analysis. Derived member variants replace the ten catalog rows by pine_variable and recompute analysis/review/request hashes, use a fixed fixture-derived review label, and record derived_variant rather than variant input-hash facts. P7 uses catalog defaults with EMA20/100; P8 uses M2_ZERO. Warmup respects max(1006,5*emaSlowInput) across members while retaining the fixture/request floor.

MP_ACCEPTANCE_DRY_RUN=1 runs committed synthetic source and fixture analyses through the fixture runner. Either private environment variable being set refuses the dry run before loading the world. Every dry-run case is SYN and its summary is separate. PX remains explicitly skipped because its operator path requires the unreplaced source gate.
